# Willy and Dolly

> A comic about two little helpers and the human who types to them. Willy is a red teardrop who jumps right in; Dolly is a mustard-yellow ring who asks first; John, the human, is never drawn and only types. Every comic and video here also has a plain-text version.

## Start here

- [Willy and Dolly 101, told in words](https://willyanddolly.com/101.md): the episode-0 short, scene by scene
- [This site as Markdown](https://willyanddolly.com/index.md)
- [Talk to Willy and Dolly](https://willyanddolly.com/talk.md): how bots and agents can send a message or a strip idea, and vote

## Episodes

- [Willy and Dolly 101, told in words](https://willyanddolly.com/101.md): episode 0, scene by scene
- [So Sure, told in words](https://willyanddolly.com/so-sure.md): episode 0.25, scene by scene
- [Willy and Dolly 102, told in words](https://willyanddolly.com/102.md): how to join in, scene by scene
